textRun.content: Cottonworld — Men’s Collection Content & Link Review

The errors are confirmed and affect all 10 collection pages that currently contain long-form “Read More” copy. Across 153 body-link occurrences, 94 need attention: 42 point to 404 destinations, 46 use search instead of dedicated collections, five lead to an empty Joggers collection, and one sends “Organic Cotton Collection” to Men’s All.

The T-shirt page alone has 10 incorrect link occurrences out of 16: three 404 links, six search links, and one wrong-collection link. Its two reported naming errors are also live. This is an inspection and correction list; storefront content has not been changed.

Scope: the supplied men’s landing page, all 24 men-specific collection destinations found in its body/navigation, the shared Top Picks destination, and 10 additional collection URLs from the reference sheet (35 collection URLs in total). Full available collection descriptions, headings and related-collection anchors were reviewed. Product-detail pages and paginated product inventories are outside this content review.

Evidence: live HTTP responses and extracted page content, the supplied sheet, and browser checks of T-shirts, Shirts, Joggers, Kurtas and New Arrivals. All recommended replacement collection URLs returned HTTP 200 with the expected collection identity. Two Polo search URLs returned HTTP 429 verification challenges; their search-path mismatch is confirmed, but their search results were not verified. This is a targeted content/link review, not a full technical SEO audit.

Low priority · Status: fail · Confidence: high · Owner: Content editor. Apply “Men’s” consistently to possessive collection names, anchors and headings. This is a display-copy correction, not an instruction to change URL handles. Labels such as “Shop Men” and phrases such as “for men” remain grammatically correct.
T-Shirts — Complete Your Look: “Men'sT Chinos” → “Men’s Chinos”; “Mens Kurtas” → “Men’s Kurtas.” The live wording is plural “Kurtas,” rather than the singular example in the request.
Shirts — first copy heading: replace the stray opening quotation mark after “Online” with a dash. Intro: “problem ”most” → “problem: most.”

Shorts — first copy heading: replace the stray opening quotation mark before “Premium” with a dash and a space. Intro: “fabrics think” → “fabrics, including”. Pure Linen Shorts paragraph: “a matching Men’s Linen Shirts” → “a matching men’s linen shirt” and retain its corrected hyperlink.
Pants — The Smart-Casual Office: “a tucked-in Men’s Polos” → “a tucked-in men’s polo shirt.”

Cotton — Everyday Cotton Polos: “Our Men’s Polo combine” → “Our men’s polo shirts combine”. Smart-Casual Office Look: include the final “s” inside the “Men’s Chinos” hyperlink; it currently sits outside the anchor.
Travel — FAQ 2: “texture. it shows” → “texture. It shows.”
Summer — introductory paragraph: add a sentence break in “at the same time you just need the right materials.” The next paragraph also needs punctuation in “fibers think”.

New Arrivals and the repeated collection-navigation label: use “Men’s New Arrivals” instead of “Men's new arrivals” for title-case consistency. Standardize T-Shirt/T-Shirts in collection labels; product-card titles currently mix Tshirt and T-Shirt.

Medium priority · Status: fail · Confidence: high · Owner: Merchandising. The Kurtas collection publicly displays “Men's White Linen Cotton Regular Fit Kurta Shirt (Copy) - Testing”. Confirm whether it is a legitimate sale item; remove the test label if legitimate, or unpublish the test product if not. Evidence:

Medium priority · Status: fail (internal contradiction) · Confidence: high · Owner: Content editor + product team. Cotton copy describes the range as “100% premium natural cotton” while including Cotton Bamboo and Cotton Elastane blends in the same sentence. Describe the range as cotton and cotton blends; reserve 100% cotton for verified products.

Medium priority · Status: not_checked_blocked (substantiation) · Confidence: high that claims are present; product-performance truth unverified · Owner: Product team. Source or qualify claims including “No fading, no sagging” (T-shirts), four-way stretch (Work, Travel, Pants), pre-washed fabrics (Work, Brunch, Shirts), garments being garment-dyed (Cotton, T-shirts, Shorts), bamboo odor resistance (T-shirts, Travel, Summer), and instant/minutes drying or cooling below ambient temperature (Linen, Summer, Shirts, Pants, Shorts). No supporting product tests or supplier documentation were supplied. Next action: obtain evidence or remove the absolute promise.

Medium priority · Status: fail against saved brand voice · Confidence: high · Owner: Content editor. Across the 10 long-form descriptions, repeated hype such as “mandatory,” “unbeatable,” “ultimate,” and “king” conflicts with Cottonworld’s calm, practical voice. Reduce blanket claims and pressure-led styling advice. This is an editorial finding, not an AI-detector result.

Low priority · Status: fail (hierarchy consistency) · Confidence: high · Owner: Shopify developer/content editor. Nine descriptions encode their section headings as H1, producing 8–10 H1s per page. Shirts was also confirmed in the browser. Keep the collection name as the page H1; use H2 for major copy sections and H3 for subsections. T-shirts instead uses H3 for all its major copy sections; align it with the same hierarchy. This is a structure correction, not a claim of a ranking penalty.
The sheet itself contains errors, so its links should be validated before bulk replacement. Owner: collection-sheet maintainer. Confidence: high.
Active Collections H27:H28 — Men’s and Women’s Bamboo URLs are swapped. The Men row should use
. Confirm the Women row separately before changing it; this review does not audit women’s collection content.
A87 — the Men’s Shorts label contains a Women’s Shorts URL. Replace the label with “Men’s Shorts”; H87 already has the correct
E116 — Men’s 100% Linen Pants is incorrectly named “Men’s 100% Linen Shirts”. The public URL in H116 is the Pants collection and returned HTTP 200.
H6 — Men’s Top Picks points to
, which returned HTTP 404. The live shared Top Picks navigation uses
. Confirm the intended men-only collection before replacing the sheet value.
H58 — the row is marked Men but points to the mixed-gender /collections/monsoon page. The dedicated men’s route is /collections/mens-monsoon (H56). Clarify the row’s intended gender.

G111:G113 repeat the same Shopify admin collection ID as the Cotton Linen entry, despite listing different public collections. Flag for the Shopify administrator to verify; admin destinations were not opened or validated in this public-site audit.

Rows in the reference sheet without a public storefront URL were not treated as live collection pages. Women’s content, private Shopify settings, product-detail pages, mobile/accessibility, schema, keyword demand and analytics were not audited. Existing copy was reviewed; no blog was written, no ZeroGPT pass is claimed, and no publish-ready rewrite is being delivered.

Next action: the Shopify content editor should replace all 89 incorrect destination occurrences, Merchandising should resolve the five Joggers links and the testing product, and the content editor should apply the copy corrections. Then recheck the updated rendered descriptions and every changed link. Expected impact: fewer dead-end journeys and clearer paths to the intended collections; no traffic or revenue uplift is estimated.
Provenance run: 20260916-mens-collection-review. Raw collection captures, reference-sheet values, destination responses, per-link statuses and browser notes are recorded in the Cottonworld audit log.
